# developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Articles — Guides — Recurring Billing

> 9 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Articles — Guides under Recurring Billing. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Recurring Billing

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/recurring-billing/overview): With Braintree's recurring billing, you can charge your customers automatically in monthly increments.
- [Plans](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/recurring-billing/plans): Before creating subscriptions, you must create a plan.
- [Subscriptions](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/recurring-billing/subscriptions): A subscription allows you to charge your customers automatically in monthly increments for a service or product. The sections below will help you manage your subscriptions.
- [Billing Cycles](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/recurring-billing/billing-cycles): Our recurring billing feature allows you to specify the length of a billing cycle, the billing date for a plan or subscription, and the number of billing cycles a subscription…
- [Add-ons and Discounts](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/recurring-billing/add-ons-discounts): You can use add-ons to charge customers for additional features or services on top of the normal subscription price.
- [Trial Periods](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/recurring-billing/trial-periods): Trial periods have a certain amount of inherent risk.
- [Email Notifications](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/recurring-billing/email-notifications): If you want to send email receipts to your customers for every successful sale transaction or refund, see [Email…
- [Advanced Settings](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/recurring-billing/recurring-advanced-settings): Under **Settings** > **Account Settings** > **Recurring Billing** > **Options**, you can determine whether you would like to automatically retry failed transactions and whether…
- [Mastercard Requirements for Negative Option Billing and Subscriptions](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/recurring-billing/mastercard-requirements): From September 22, 2022, Mastercard is implementing new requirements for certain negative option billing merchants and for merchants who use a subscription model.
